cases.name: Lost acknowledgment survives real reload and GET-only recovery without duplicate creation
Explicit retry after not_received uses immutable body and operation ID
Cancellation fence is confirmed before pending intent is cleared
Real Web Locks and cross-tab storage permit only one creation operation
Malformed success response keeps draft and never announces creation
Auth loading hides pending recovery and sends no private recovery request
New actor remounts fresh settings and cannot see previous actor pending operation
Actor ABA suppresses stale save acknowledgment and resets private form scope

scope: Actual full settings page, durable hook and transport in native headless Chrome. Real Web Locks, storage events, reload, DOM input and button actions; loopback synthetic HTTP/auth/motion only. External networking blocked. No actual OAuth/Next/production database/provider execution.
